dataNotes: Run timing: this cycle ran the morning of 30 October 2026 after the GitHub Actions fetch job drafted contracts/*.2026-10-29.json from Thursday 29 October's close. Every figure used is dated at or before 2026-10-29; news-log entries dated 30 October (overnight futures slide, BoJ) were NOT used.

Bonds, dollar and IWM sigma are not auto-fetched; the last obtainable implied-volatility values (TLT 30-day IV, EUR/USD 1-month ATM IV, RVX) were carried forward again with their original stale-source notes.
News-log entries for 2026-10-29 (six, identical in the news database and data/news_log.json; no hand-entered entries) were read. No separate web search was run, to keep the blindness rule clean.

Category 1-12 votes are neutral by design except Trend structure (following the computed structure reads), the Fed-path votes for bonds (bear), gold (bear) and dollar (bull) grounded in the 10-2 hawkish hold, and the Nasdaq-100 earnings vote (bear, Alphabet-led selloff); the mechanical Market structure category carries its own direction.
